race.comment: ANDERSHINE (1) has earned top billing after a last-start Mdn win at this track over the 1600m. The figure he put up last start to score stacks up in this field and this looks to shape similarly. Can repeat the dose in what looks a very suitable CL1 assignment. BLACK IRISH (3) has to rebound from a plain run at Belmont, yet that was in metro company and his previous CL2 run at this venue was much better. Expecting a return for form. HEAVENLY RAPTURE (7) returns from six weeks off after a heavy Kalgoorlie defeat, but she drops from NMW1Y and CL2 lines and rates well enough on the broader figures to be a genuine danger if sharper. SUNDAY MASS (13) is backing up quickly after a fair fourth at Belmont and had charged home at Northam two back. She has to be included. SECRETCHINO (8) won't be far away.
